notes.title: Interface and Feature Updates
notes.content:
Hello Players!
In our latest update, we've made the following improvements:

1.Simple Pomodoro Timer
Let this countdown timer help organize your work sessions. We've marked the recommended 25-minute work and 5-minute break intervals with red notches. Features include "pause" and "reset" functions. 
More timer designs are planned for future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780282/1f3218987feccceb7e5e4d304a046b5547ae6481.png[/img]

2.Always on Top
You can now minimize the window, place it in a corner, and lock it to stay on top of other windows. Perfect for taking quick glances during your work.

3.Interface Updates
We've redesigned how buttons are displayed to prevent them from taking up too much screen space as we add more features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780282/5f8b70554463a478d9aa575141f5c35a3547883a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780282/3d34775cad81920a510690f55d80a7c09e4132ce.png[/img]

4.Dynamic Room Objects
Indoor objects will now change as the story progresses. The current version includes two distinct stages.

We are currently developing a new theme in parallel, maybe it will be announced in the next update?
Well, see you next time.

notes.title: Demo Update - New Radio Programs Added
notes.content:
Hello players!

In today's update, we've added new radio programs. These programs will appear randomly at various times of the day.

We'd like to extend our heartfelt thanks to Lutralutra and Nemesis from SpringFish for providing the content for this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780282/69973584674af38b2cb2a988a6c6b2f1335c56e6.png[/img]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/@Lutra_rescute]Lutralutra[/url]
A virtual streamer reincarnated from a Kinmen Eurasian otter. Loves drinking flammable clear water (Kaoliang liquor).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780282/f941c7c6cf4c22d9138cb8a04d8d52a8f14612c4.png[/img]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/@NemesisXDFP]Nemesis[/url]
Hailing from the Xtreme Deep Field Project. May this song reach every corner of Earth.

Additionally, we've added an original fairy tale radio program.
This program was recorded with the help of Chilla and Hatsuki.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780282/b217a8a2f822571beb3515d0305c3e0f9d38c16a.png[/img]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/@STORIANarrator]Chilla[/url]
A terrifying magical beast summoned by a game company, now working to make ends meet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780282/46eae4da86fed2dde0bc650e695716d86a915d6a.png[/img]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/AxHxASMR/]Hatsuki[/url]
Listen to voices, sleep well, live a good life.

Note: The linked pages are in Chinese.

We're constantly adding more content! If you're interested in providing audio files suitable for our radio programs, please contact us.

We plan to add even more content in the future.
Don't miss out on our latest updates! Please follow us to stay informed.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello players!
In our latest demo update, we've made the following changes:

1.Significantly improved performance to prevent excessive system resource usage
2.Fixed screen border issues for non-16:9 aspect ratios

Even for the demo version, we're committed to making adjustments based on player feedback. Our next update is planned to include more radio programs. Stay tuned for future updates!

Thank you for your support.

tags.bug: 2.Fixed screen border issues for non-16:9 aspect ratios

notes.title: "Alice's World" Steam Page released, the girl hears "your" voice from in front of the screen
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/bcb8ac1e2aa0c4c98220fb152a0303ecce06e954.png[/img]
Alice's World is a story-driven 2D adventure puzzle game.
The girl opens her eyes in a desolate world, and hears "your" voice from in front of the screen.
You can direct her actions, help her solve mysteries, evade dangers, and find a way to leave this place. Of course, you could also choose not to do so, or even worse, deliberately guide her to death... Just kidding, you surely wouldn't do that, right?
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2439560/Alices_World/
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/b49d52caa40ed999c4231937661499124b6de4ac.jpg[/img]
[h2]【Game Features】[/h2]
[list][*]There is no role-playing! You are yourself, sitting in front of the screen, guiding the in-game character.
[*]Explore the stories hidden behind the desolate world, unravel the truth layer by layer.
[*]Exquisite Japanese-style art and full voice acting bring an immersive experience.[/list]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/9e79f45938240209d61449759220516509a38062.jpg[/img][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/4d1759dee13a21b06e099af803e9f7edc449b451.gif[/img][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/ecf8e07845fac84ee2d416a0815515e55ad313e2.jpg[/img]
[h1]【Story Rich】[/h1]
